root_cause.mechanism: different per-thread k-association between the two kernels
root_cause.legacy_kernel: gguf_k_pack8_prefill_out_kernel: k += blockDim.x (unit stride, one element per thread per iteration), acc += xv * w
root_cause.decode_kernel: vec_stride = blockDim.x * 8 with eight consecutive k per thread and the per-block scale hoisted, acc = fmaf(xv, d * qs, acc)
root_cause.consequence: per-thread partial sums cover different k-sets, so f32 rounding differs and a small fraction of bf16 outputs land one ULP apart
root_cause.measured_rate: 1-2 differing elements per 8192 at blk.5.attn_q.weight (in=2816, out=8192); 0 of 6 other real dense tensors probed in a single pass
root_cause.both_kernels_accurate: each is within one bf16 ulp of the f32 CPU oracle at all seven real dense shapes (tests/test_gpu_gguf_q8_0_pack8_gemv_decode_parity.py)
root_cause.feasibility: the eight-consecutive/hoisted-scale walk IS the optimization, so bit-exactness and the speed trick are mutually exclusive at this design point
